details:
* SECURITY UPDATE: out-of-bounds write in mod_charset_lite
     - debian/patches/CVE-2026-56153.patch: in finish_partial_char() in
       modules/filters/mod_charset_lite.c, stop accumulating a split
       multibyte character once ctx->saved reaches the size of ctx->buf so
       the next byte can no longer be written past the 8-byte buffer.
       Backported from httpd commit 6654234dcb395e07fd62255670356f84ec733195
       (SVN r1938658).
     - CVE-2026-56153
   * SECURITY UPDATE: use-after-free in mod_rewrite lookahead variables
     - debian/patches/CVE-2026-56154.patch: in lookup_variable() in
       modules/mappers/mod_rewrite.c, copy ctx->vary_this into the main
       request pool after an LA-U/LA-F lookahead sub-request so the Vary
       header name no longer points into the destroyed sub-request pool.
       Backported from httpd commit 6e4d1e614597109909dda495d235b6a1331d7beb
       (SVN r1938660).
     - CVE-2026-56154
   * SECURITY UPDATE: out-of-bounds write in mod_proxy_html
     - debian/patches/CVE-2026-56449.patch: in pcomment() in
       modules/filters/mod_proxy_html.c, do not call dump_content() after
       writing an HTML comment so crafted response bodies can no longer
       trigger a write outside the output buffer. Backported from httpd
       commit c721d4e1cf5c142149509490015cef1a75715595 (SVN r1935931).
     - CVE-2026-56449
   * SECURITY UPDATE: stack-based buffer overflow in mod_vhost_alias
     - debian/patches/CVE-2026-63292.patch: in vhost_alias_checkspace()
       and vhost_alias_interpolate() in modules/mappers/mod_vhost_alias.c,
       reject a single expanded segment (e.g. a Host header) of
       HUGE_STRING_LEN bytes or more with 414 instead of writing past the
       stack buffer. Backported from httpd commit
       7ed3f91688b7a1e1ac48486fd2e5eeb2932e879f (SVN r1938675).
     - CVE-2026-63292
   * SECURITY UPDATE: use-after-free in mod_http2 via session->bbtmp
     - debian/patches/CVE-2026-57941.patch: in modules/http2/h2_session.c,
       h2_c1_io.c and h2_mplx.c, use a per-call brigade instead of the
       shared session->bbtmp in on_send_data_cb() and ev_stream_closed(),
       remove buckets before feeding them, guard stream cleanup against
       re-entrancy with in_stream_cleanup/mplx_cleanup_done, and allocate
       the input/output iqueues from a separate pool. Backported from
       httpd commit d072ed8f06d66a30072227d61a2fc04ad9ae5c99
       (SVN r1938665).
     - CVE-2026-57941
